number.description: the sequence number; two branches may each append the next one

previous.description: the digest of the entry before it on its branch; required from number 2 on, absent on the first entry

kind.description: what the command did, such as promote or retire

entity.description: the entity kind and its key, such as rule:store.schemas.2

before.description: absent when the entity is new

plan.description: the digest of the plan the yes accepted

command.description: the command the yes agreed to, as a person types it, without --apply; guard staged replays it to recompute the plan digest. Absent on a line written before it was recorded

decision.description: the decision the entry records, when the command takes one

reverts.description: the digest of the entry an undo takes back, as previous names one; absent on every other entry

statements.description: the digest of each rule's statement as the conversion wrote it, keyed by rule id; on a migrate entry only, and empty when the rulebook held no rule; a key that names no rule holds nothing
